note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each ward of Londonderry Corporation; nominations Monday 6 January 1930. There was no opposition anywhere, so there was no poll. No nominations were made for the West Ward, whose retiring councillors, William Quigley (L.) and Bernard Doherty (L.), were deemed re-elected (Derry Journal, 8 January 1930). No nominations were made for the West Ward; its two retiring councillors were deemed re-elected. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
